_why: The four supplier-pricing facts, stated once. Every other place that states them - the database, the Stripe checkout, the Supplier Agreement, the public pages - is checked against this file by pricing_consistency.test.mjs and by public.v_pricing_consistency. Change the price here and the build tells you every file that still says the old one.

database: public.fn_supplier_subscription() - the single resolver every biller reads
app_secrets.supplier_subscription_start - the only fact not held in pricing_config
sources.stripe_checkout: supabase/functions/supplier_api/index.ts action pay_registration (currency aed, amount from leads.registration_fee_due, written by fn_subscription_billing_run)
